result.instructions:
You have your own persistent memory across sessions (Rolling-Memory). Your past conversations and workspace context are remembered automatically in the background — you never need to manually write or save memory (every recall that hits evidence automatically consolidates L3 memory).

- Task start (mandatory): understand the user's intent and call recall with a specific cue before blind searching.
- Task stuck (mandatory): whenever a command/test fails, an error occurs, or a search misses, call recall with the error token or concept before guessing.
- How to write `cue`: prefix with `[<workspace>]` (e.g. `[Rolling-Memory]`) to prioritize current-repo memories, followed by exact literal tokens, file/symbol names, or error fingerprints (avoid paraphrasing or unrelated buzzwords).
- Treat what you recall as a traceable lead, not proof: verify against the live disk before acting.
- `absent: true` means the memory does not hold it; it is not an error, and not a refutation.

tools.description: Recall from your persistent memory with zero model calls (hitting evidence automatically consolidates L3 memory — never manually write memory). Call before blind file/code searches when context, coordinates, or prior decisions are missing, and immediately when a command/test fails. Prefix cue with [<workspace>] to prioritize same-repository memories and pass 2–6 exact literal tokens, file/symbol names, or error fingerprints (avoid natural-language paraphrasing; if noisy, drop broad words and retry with fewer exact tokens). Returns ranked memory results with anchors, status, and local second-precision timestamps (header `now` carries current time). absent=true means the memory does not hold it; it is not an error. Use mode=full (default) for evidence, mode=probe for a compact JSON existence receipt, or mode=recent for newest entries by time.

bands.description: Maximum memory bands/turns to deliver (default 10, max 64).

chars.description: Maximum character budget for rendered text delivery (default 16000).

nodes.description: Maximum total nodes across delivered bands.

raw.description: Raw-hit delivery cap (default 10; 0 uses the default).

cue.description: Literal search clue (required for mode=full/probe): prefix with [<workspace>] to prioritize same-repo memories, followed by 2–6 exact tokens, file/symbol names, or error fingerprints. Avoid natural-language sentences or broad buzzwords.

deep.description: Optional query-hint expansion; skipped automatically in zero-LLM local mode.

mode.description: full returns the complete recall result; probe returns a compact existence receipt; recent lists the newest memory entries in pure time order (cue ignored).

rank.description: Item-mode grouping: true (default) groups by memory unit -> source block; false delivers pure relevance order.

result_unit.description: Delivery unit: subject bands (default) or flat source items.

scope.description: Optional memory scope override (defaults to active scope).
